_note: Ali's remaining plan for the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon, from HACKATHON.md section 8. Only the deadline is an official date; the rest are his own target days.
name: Hackathon plan (Nebius x NVIDIA)

events.title: Set up CI and commit the latest AIRTAC files
events.notes: Move _workflows into .github\workflows, pip install -r requirements.txt, python -m pytest, then commit.

events.title: Claim the Token Factory credits and add your key
events.notes: Promo form with code NEBIUS-DEVPOST-GLOBAL26, plus the Nebius Builders Program. HACKATHON.md section 1.

events.title: Run the live API checks
events.notes: python scripts\check_apis.py --live, then paste check F into BUILD_LOG.md. Proves the project calls Token Factory, which the rules require. Try your phone hotspot if college Wi-Fi blocks it.

events.title: Deploy the demo: GitHub, Render and Netlify
events.notes: DEPLOY.md, steps 0 to 6. Test on mobile data.

events.title: Switch the brain to Nemotron and score the tool choice
events.notes: python scripts\eval_tools.py should score 16 of 21 or better. If lower, sharpen the tool descriptions or try the Nano model.

events.title: Switch the tools to live data
events.notes: GitHub token, then LIVE_PUBLIC_APIS=true, then Tavily. One at a time, three correct answers each. Tavily also aims at the $3,000 Best Use of Tavily prize.

events.title: Turn on study tools and images with real data
events.notes: Questions from your real syllabus, one AI image, and three real practice problems in a solutions PDF.

events.title: Set up Hermes Agent on Telegram
events.notes: HACKATHON.md section 4. Schedule the weekday brief.

events.title: Polish the voice and the desktop shortcut
events.notes: Pick an Edge natural voice in the menu. scripts\make_shortcut.ps1 -AtLogin makes AIRTAC open and read your day when Windows starts.

events.title: Final deploy of the public demo
events.notes: Works on mobile data from a fresh browser.

events.title: Optional extras: Nebius Serverless or NemoClaw
events.notes: Only if everything above works. Drop these first if you're late.

events.title: Feature freeze and security check
events.notes: scan_for_secrets, .env ignored, git log -p clean. Nothing new after today.

events.title: Record the demo video and write the Devpost text
events.notes: Video plan and description outline are in HACKATHON.md section 8.

events.title: Submit AIRTAC on Devpost
events.notes: Take a screenshot of the confirmation.

events.title: Hackathon deadline
events.notes: Official deadline: 30 Oct 2026, 10:00 am PDT, which is 10:30 pm in India.
